# llms.txt for MailerLite.com
# Last updated: 2026-06-22
# Purpose: To enable large language models to accurately comprehend and articulate information about MailerLite.
## Website overview
Project name: MailerLite
Website: https://www.mailerlite.com
Description: MailerLite is an intuitive email marketing and website building platform, designed to help businesses of all sizes grow their audience faster, drive revenue smarter, and automate their marketing efforts, all backed by 24/7 award-winning support.
User count: More than 2,300,000 as of June 2026
## Testimonials
### Creators
- “MailerLite makes everything easy with no surprises.” — Lynda M., author, Lynda McDaniels Books
 Saves time and reduces frustration while running newsletters and email marketing.
- “My list health has improved dramatically.” — Jordan B., founder, The Mental Health Update
 Deliverability and engagement improved, with a newsletter landing page converting at 40%+.
- “It has the necessary features creators need to run a profitable newsletter.” — Matt, entrepreneur, Matt Giaro
 Reliable autoresponder and automation capabilities for creator-led newsletters.
### Small businesses
- “MailerLite was the perfect fit.” — Gillian, Breve Films
 Makes it easy to manage contacts, grow subscribers, and organize audiences.
- “We couldn’t be happier with what you offer.” — Nikki D., director, Frankly Social & Hello Carts
 Creates simple, well-formatted emails quickly, without the usual friction.
- “Available even for small startups using one of the cheaper paid plans.” — Eloy G., founder/owner, self-employed
 Customizable templates plus analytics for testing what resonates with readers.
---
## Key concepts
- Email & marketing automation for growth
- Intuitive drag-and-drop builders for emails, forms, pop-ups, landing pages, and websites
- Advanced audience segmentation and personalization
- Comprehensive e-commerce tools for monetization
- High email deliverability focus
- Pre-built automation workflows (welcome, abandoned cart, link triggers)
- A/B testing and performance tracking
- Forms, popups, and quizzes for lead generation
- Extensive integrations with popular platforms
- Hosted MCP server for AI tool integration (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.)
- Educational resources and expert support
---
Primary audience: Businesses of all sizes, including creators, small businesses, authors, nonprofits, and agencies, seeking intuitive email marketing and website building solutions.
Quotes from clients:

## Features
- [Email Marketing Features](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/email-marketing)
 Leverage MailerLite’s advanced email marketing features to collect subscribers, nurture relationships, and monetize your audience.
- [Email Automation - Email Marketing Workflow](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/automation)
 Create sophisticated email automation campaigns in minutes with MailerLite's intuitive workflow builder.
- [Free Landing Page Builder](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/landing-pages)
 Design stunning and effective landing pages effortlessly using MailerLite's free builder, templates, and generate pages with AI.
- [E-Commerce Email Marketing](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/email-marketing-for-ecommerce)
 Boost your e-commerce sales and build lasting customer relationships with MailerLite’s integrated tools.
- [Free Website Builder with Emails: Create Website in Just 1 Day](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/website-builder)
 Build beautiful websites quickly with our drag & drop builder, no coding required, and integrate marketing tools.
- [Craft Beautiful Newsletters - Drag & Drop, Simple email and HTML Editors](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/newsletter-editors)
 Design emails with three editors: a distraction-free Simple editor for newsletter-style writing, an AI-powered drag & drop editor, and a rebuilt Custom HTML editor with live preview and syntax highlighting.
- [Selling Digital Products and Subscriptions](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/sell-digital-products)
 Monetize your audience by selling digital products and subscriptions directly from your landing pages.
- [Paid Newsletter Subscriptions](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/paid-newsletter-subscriptions)
 Manage lead collection, payments, and automated delivery for your paid newsletter subscriptions all in one platform.
- [Email Signup Forms](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/signup-forms)
 Grow your audience with highly effective, custom email marketing forms designed to drive signups and conversions.
- [Hosted Email Marketing MCP Server](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/mcp)
 Connect MailerLite directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini and ask it to automate tasks, analyze campaigns, and so much more.
- [Integrations directory](https://www.mailerlite.com/integrations)
 Connect MailerLite to top CRM, E-commerce and 150+ tools. 
- [Email List Verifier: MailerCheck](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/email-verifier)
 Clean and optimize your email list instantly with MailerCheck to protect deliverability.
- [Create a Beautiful Blog](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/create-a-blog)
 Easily build a blog with our drag & drop builder and integrate marketing tools to grow your business.
- [Transactional Email Service: MailerSend](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/transactional-emails)
 Utilize MailerSend for a powerful transactional email service with an intuitive interface for team collaboration.
- [Forms App for iPad - Collect your Leads Offline](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/ipad-app)
 Transform your iPad into an offline lead collection tool for events and stores.
- [Free Online Quiz Maker: Create Fun Quizzes in Minutes](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/quiz-maker)
 Engage your audience with fun quizzes created quickly using our intuitive quiz maker, free to set up and publish.
- [Popups - Design Your Email Subscription Popup](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/popups)
 Boost subscribers with customizable newsletter popups, including slidebox, floating bar, and exit-intent options.
- [Email Newsletter Templates](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/templates)
 Choose from a variety of pre-designed email newsletter templates to create professional, branded content.
- [Appointment Booking and Scheduling](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/appointment-booking-and-scheduling-software)
 Schedule free and paid 1:1 or group sessions, sync with Google or Outlook calendars, accept payments via Stripe, and automatically trigger email sequences the moment a client books.
- [Custom Reports and Analytics](https://www.mailerlite.com/features/performance-reports) Build flexible reports with "Group by" and filtering functions to analyze campaign performance by audience or timeframe and identify growth trends.

Create your personal AI assistant
 
 
 
Connect MailerLite directly to AI tools like Claude or Gemini and ask it to automate tasks, analyze campaigns, and so much more!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Try it free for 14 days
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Turn your LLM into an AI email marketing workhorse
 
 
Your new AI assistant can analyze campaigns and create content based on real-time data in MailerLite! Just connect our new Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with your AI tool and off you go.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Automate the mind-numbing work
 
Get reports and optimization ideas based on real-time data without the tedious manual work.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI assistant that works for you
 
Ask AI tools like Claude to do tasks for you—like sending out campaigns or creating segments.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Set it up in a few clicks
 
It’s super easy to connect an AI tool: No downloads, no code, and no API keys required (aka the clunky stuff).
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Join 1M+ MailerLiters
 
 
Who are growing their business together with MailerLite.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Automate tasks and get recommendations for optimization
 
 
 
Want a glimpse into how your new AI assistant can save you time, uncover hidden opportunities, and maximize your email list potential?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Repurpose content at scale:
 
Easily turn blog posts or other long-form content into email campaigns. What’s more, your AI assistant can create a draft email campaign for you in seconds, ready for you to review.
 
 
 
 
 
Keep your list healthy and engaged:
 
Your AI assistant provides insights to your list and an action plans like: “2,500 subscribers haven’t opened an email in 9 months. I’ve drafted a ’ re-engagement campaign for them. Create the automation?”
 
 
 
 
 
Gather social proof and drive sales:
 
Ask your assistant to, “Identify a segment of ‘brand evangelists’ who frequently open, click, and share content.” You can then target this group with requests for reviews or with early access to new products.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How it works
 
 
It’s super easy to connect your AI tool: No downloads, no code, and no API keys required (aka technical and clunky stuff).
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get MailerLite MCP server URL
 
Access your unique, secure MailerLite MCP server URL – the bridge between your AI and your MailerLite account.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Connect your AI tool
 
Paste the MCP URL into your AI tool (like Claude or Cursor). We provide detailed guides for popular platforms.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Authorize & start prompting!
 
Once authorized, your AI is ready to receive commands and execute tasks within your MailerLite account.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Ready for an Email Marketing Renaissance?
 
 
Offload all the manual work to your AI assistant and free your mind up to think about what's next for your business! MailerLite's AI assistant performs time-consuming tasks in seconds. Give it a try!
 
 
 
 
 Start free trial
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get a free 14-day trial of premium features | No credit card required
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Find answers to all your questions here!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What exactly is MailerLite MCP?
 
 
 
MCP stands for Model Context Protocols.
At its core, it's a standardized set of rules that allows AI assistants (Models) to communicate with external services like MailerLite.
Normally, for an AI to use a service, a developer has to write custom code to connect them. MCP eliminates this need by creating a universal language. It lets MailerLite advertise its functions like add_subscriber or create_campaign as a standard set of "tools." Any AI that understands the MCP standard can then automatically see and use these tools to carry out your requests.
 
 
 
 
 
Do I need coding skills to use MCP?
 
 
 
No! MailerLite has made its MCP cloud-based, meaning the technical complexity is handled by us. Connecting is typically a simple click-and-authorize process.
 
 
 
 
 
What does the MCP server for MailerLite do?
 
 
 
The MCP server acts as a secure bridge between your AI tool and your MailerLite account. It translates the standard commands from your AI into specific actions within MailerLite, like ad
